# `effectSleepZeroToYieldNow`

Suggests Effect.yieldNow for cooperative yielding instead of sleeping for zero duration

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377142` |
| Language Service name | `effectSleepZeroToYieldNow` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/effect-sleep-zero-to-yield-now` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

export const cooperativeYield = Effect.sleep(0)
/**
                                ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(effect-sleep-zero-to-yield-now): Consider `Effect.yieldNow` for cooperative yielding instead of sleeping for zero duration.
*/
```
